article.headline: Carson Johnson scores 33 as Denver beats Oral Roberts 98-87
article.description: — Carson Johnson's 33 points led Denver over Oral Roberts 98-87 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Carson Johnson scores 33 as Denver beats Oral Roberts 98-87

categories.description: Oral Roberts Golden Eagles @ Denver Pioneers

event.description: Oral Roberts Golden Eagles @ Denver Pioneers

keywords: Oral Roberts Golden Eagles @ Denver Pioneers
article.story: DENVER -- — Carson Johnson's 33 points led Denver over Oral Roberts 98-87 on Wednesday. Johnson shot 9 for 16 (4 for 7 from 3-point range) and 11 of 11 from the free-throw line for the Pioneers (9-11, 2/3 Summit League). Zane Nelson scored 20 points and added seven rebounds. Jeremiah Burke shot 8 for 14, including 2 for 5 from beyond the arc to finish with 20 points, while adding seven rebounds. The Golden Eagles (5-14, 0-4) were led by Connor Dow, who posted 23 points and two steals. Oral Roberts also got 18 points from Ty Harper. Yuto Yamanouchi-Williams finished with 10 points. The loss is the seventh in a row for the Golden Eagles. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
